title: Save Status - Download Status
summary: Save status app helps you to download and save status images and videos.
description:
Looking to download images and videos from someone else’s WhatsApp statuses?

You've come to the right place!

Save Status - Download Status is the ultimate app for downloading and saving WhatsApp statuses. With a single tap, you can save and download status images, videos, and other media. No need to take screenshots or crop images to save your desired statuses. Our app simplifies the process and saves everything in one place!

Easily downloads WhatsApp Status Videos with the help of status saver app.

You can manage WhatsApp Status or download status with the help of status saver app features.

How it works:
-------------------
• Open the desired status that you want to save.
• Open the app and click on any images or videos to view them.
• Click the download button to save videos or images to your gallery!

Simple, Effective, & Easy to Use

Save anyone's status updates from WhatsApp business with just a tap. Whether it's images, videos, or other media, you can download it from your friend's status updates and save it to your gallery for easy access.

View and Save in High Resolution

The app allows you to view recent status updates in full resolution, making it easy to see the details of each update.

To view an image or video, simply click on it and then click the download button to save it to your gallery.

Save to Your Gallery or Share on Your Own Status

Save Status - Download Status makes it easy to not only save statuses to your phone, but also repost them to your own status.

Ever see a status that you really want to repost for yourself? Our WhatsApp status saver makes it super easy. No need to take a screenshot!

You can also easily use the saved media as the background on your own phone.

View Time-Limited Statuses for as Long as You Like

Tired of losing WhatsApp Statuses that disappear after 24-hours? Use our WhatsApp status downloader to save them so you can see them whenever you want!

Features:
--------------
✓ Easily download anyone’s status in one click with no quality loss
✓ Save images and videos from your daily status updates
✓ Download statuses and easily share with anyone you want
✓ Download multiple statuses with a single tap
✓ Delete unwanted status to free up space in your device
✓ Offline access to the app
✓ Easily repost statuses & stories
✓ Built-in status saver, viewer, and media player
✓ Separate video tab for Save video status for WhatsApp.
✓ Separate video tab for Save video status for Business WhatsApp.

Download status to your gallery, share with your friends, report to your own status - use Save Status - Download Status for free today!
